text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything that is about to happen is not 
a dream. So, let's keep our eyes wide 
open.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make intense, unforgettable memories 
for me... and for everyone! Let's make 
every single moment—shine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her words trailed off there. But—that 
was enough. That was more than enough to 
convey her feelings."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day it was decided she would run in 
the Twinkle Series. With sparkling eyes, 
she was bursting with excitement for the 
future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she heads toward the greatest 
conclusion right now— Fine Motion is more 
beautiful than in any of my memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-chan! I'm so happy we get to run 
together again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The thought that I might not be able to be 
with Fine-san anymore made me think long 
and hard about everything.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I feel so lonely, but... I realized that's 
not how I should look at it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I compared Fine-san to a story. Stories 
always come to an end... but a brand new 
chapter can always begin."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"At the end of Chapter 1 of your story, 
Fine-san... please let me add my name to 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aha, that's so cool. Robroy-chan, you look 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Please, let my name be carved into your 
heart as well."
